results.question: How much did we sell this year compared with the same period last year?
results.sql:
SELECT d.year, o.channel_id,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.net_sales) / SUM(SUM(o.net_sales)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.year), 1) AS share_pct
FROM fct_orders o
JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = o.order_date
GROUP BY d.year, o.channel_id
ORDER BY d.year, share_pct DESC

results.question: What is the gross margin % by category this year?

results.question: Which promotion generated the most incremental gross margin?
results.sql:
SELECT p.promo_name, ROUND(SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.gross_margin) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM fct_order_lines l
JOIN dim_promotion p ON p.promo_code = l.promo_code
WHERE p.promo_name LIKE 'Black Friday%'
GROUP BY p.promo_name
ORDER BY p.promo_name

results.question: What is the 3-month retention of customers acquired in January 2025?
results.sql:
SELECT acquisition_channel,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(active_customers) / SUM(cohort_customers), 1) AS month_6_retention_pct
FROM mart_customer_cohorts

results.question: Which department has the most active customers?
results.sql:
WITH q AS (
    SELECT l.subcategory, d.year_quarter, SUM(l.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM fct_order_lines l
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.date = l.order_date
    WHERE d.year_quarter IN ('2025-Q2', '2026-Q2')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN year_quarter = '2026-Q2' THEN net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_2026_q2,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN year_quarter = '2025-Q2' THEN net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_2025_q2,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN year_quarter = '2026-Q2' THEN net_sales END)
             / SUM(CASE WHEN year_quarter = '2025-Q2' THEN net_sales END) - 1), 1) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM q
GROUP BY subcategory
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
